title: Eventual overlap transition existence
statement: For the directed colimit setup, compact open cover, perfect local objects and their limit comparison isomorphisms, there are k ≥ j and hjk : j ≤ k such that the exact overlap restrictions of the pullbacks of A and B at k admit an isomorphism.

proof.text: Restrict the supplied local comparison isomorphisms to the compact overlap, descend the overlap morphism and its inverse through the directed colimit using perfect morphism descent, and enlarge the stage until both composites are identities. Transport the representatives through canonical derived-pullback composition and open-restriction comparison isomorphisms to obtain the displayed overlap isomorphism.
